run_upload_gtest: run upload_gtest.py to upload a Google Test patch for review with the gtest group cc'd
run_upload_gtest_with_cc: run upload_gtest.py with a custom --cc flag to add extra reviewers to the patch upload
review_main: review the main function that wraps upload.py and auto-cc's the googletestframework group
summarize_upload_gtest: summarize the upload_gtest.py wrapper script that passes flags to upload.py with an added cc recipient
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional default cc recipients beyond the gtest group
